hook: Eccentric black hole mergers may reveal line-of-sight acceleration over ten times better than circular ones.
summary: Binaries with eccentric orbits could show whether a nearby object accelerates them, through a small shift in the gravitational-wave phase. Analyzing the signal from the first eccentric harmonic, not the usual one, adds a longer stretch of signal. Fisher forecasts and full Bayesian runs show constraints improve by more than ten times at e_20 near 0.1 for strong signals, and about 5 times for weak ones. These are simulated signals and need fast eccentric waveform models.
title: Eccentricity greatly enhances the detectability of line-of-sight acceleration in gravitational wave signals
